Welcome to the very first episode of our Slovenia Travel Series! In this video, we explore Slovenia’s most stunning lakes — Lake Bled and Lake Jasna. From the iconic Bled Castle and the picture-perfect island church to the hidden gem of Lake Jasna near Kranjska Gora, this video is packed with views, vibes, and valuable travel tips!
What you'll see in this video:
Things to do at Lake Bled — boat ride, viewpoints, Bled Castle
Where to eat (vegetarian-friendly options)
Hidden spots at Lake Jasna
How to travel between Lake Bled and Lake Jasna
